areas.title: Getting started
areas.text: A colleague who greets you, briefs you and remembers the conversation.

cards.title: “What can you do?” help menu
cards.hook: One tap shows exactly what Nyra can do for you, nothing you can't use.
cards.desc: Answers in one line and shows five capability buttons, with Load more. The list only includes what your permissions allow.
cards.happens: Answer card with tappable capability buttons.

cards.title: Greetings and introductions
cards.hook: Friendly from the first hello, with a fresh greeting every day.
cards.desc: Replies to greetings and small talk, and introduces herself when asked. Greetings change with the time of day and day of the week.
cards.happens: Short reply in the panel; spoken too if voice is on.

cards.title: Morning briefing: “What's on my plate?”
cards.hook: Start every day knowing exactly what needs you, sorted by urgency.
cards.desc: One briefing with today's interviews, feedback you owe, reminders that are due, goals and items waiting on you. Each item appears only if you can see that page.
cards.happens: Briefing card with links to each item.

cards.title: Festive and personal greetings
cards.hook: Nyra celebrates with your team: Diwali fireworks, Holi colours, birthdays and work anniversaries.
cards.desc: On festivals and holidays Nyra greets the user with a matching animation: fireworks and diyas for Diwali, gulal for Holi, snow for Christmas, a crescent for Eid, the tricolour for Independence Day and Republic Day. US holidays such as Thanksgiving are included. It also greets birthdays and work anniversaries, and sends a belated wish within three days.
prompts: (automatic when you open Nyra on the day)
cards.happens: Greeting and a short animation in the panel.
cards.note: Uses the India and US holiday sets. Moon-dependent dates such as Eid follow the published calendar.

cards.title: Spoken replies (voice)
cards.hook: Nyra can talk you through it in a natural Indian English voice.
cards.desc: Reads replies aloud once you turn on the speaker. Uses a natural Indian English voice, and a Hindi voice for Hindi replies.
cards.happens: Replies are spoken as well as written.
cards.note: Voice is off by default; each user turns it on once. Written replies always show.

cards.title: English, Hindi and Hinglish
cards.hook: Ask the way your team actually talks: English, Hindi or Hinglish.
cards.desc: Understands typed English, Hindi (Devanagari) and romanised Hinglish, and replies in the language you choose.
cards.happens: Same answers and actions, whatever the language.
cards.note: A few Hinglish flow words (for example “doosra wala” for “the other one”) are still learning.

cards.title: Past conversations
cards.hook: Pick up any conversation exactly where you left it.
cards.desc: Your chat stays when you close the panel. The same thread continues on the Chat with Nyra page, and the Nyra Conversations page lists your past chats so you can resume any of them.
cards.happens: Opens the Nyra Conversations page.

cards.title: Smart follow-ups and clarifying buttons
cards.hook: Talk naturally. Nyra keeps the thread and asks only when it really needs to.
cards.desc: Follows on from the last answer (“which ones?”, “same for last month”). When an ask is thin or ambiguous, Nyra offers buttons to choose from instead of guessing.
prompts: “Find good people then (Nyra asks: which role?)”
cards.happens: Follow-up answer, or a short question with buttons.
cards.note: Pointing at a list item (“the oldest one”) works in some flows, not all.

cards.title: Rate a reply
cards.hook: Every thumbs-up or thumbs-down makes Nyra better.
cards.desc: Thumbs up or down on any reply. The team uses this feedback to improve Nyra.
cards.happens: Feedback saved.

cards.title: Hide the floating Nyra launcher
cards.hook: Prefer a quieter screen? Hide Nyra's floating button until you want it back.
cards.desc: Each user can hide the floating Nyra launcher from their own session. Nyra and Chat with Nyra stay available from the usual pages; the floating button stays off until you turn it back on.
cards.happens: Floating launcher hides for you. Open Nyra from Chat with Nyra or the menu when you need it.
cards.note: Per user only; it doesn't hide Nyra for the whole workspace.

areas.title: Finding candidates
areas.text: Describe the person you need. Nyra finds them, refines with you, and watches for new ones.

cards.title: Plain-language candidate search
cards.hook: Type it like you'd say it. Nyra turns it into a scored search in seconds.
cards.desc: Searches your candidate database by skills, location, experience and more, and returns the best matches. It keeps what you already said (skill, city, remote, fresher) and only asks for what's still missing. “Top N only” keeps the search card and does not write a shortlist.
prompts: “Find Java developers in Bangalore with 5+ years”
cards.happens: Search card with the top matches and an Open full results button.
cards.note: Nyra asks rather than invents when the request is too vague. Zero-score matches stay hidden in AI Matches and related lists.

cards.title: Find for a job or client
cards.hook: Point Nyra at a job and it sources against it.
cards.desc: Finds candidates for a job by its code or title, or for a client (it picks the client's job or asks which one).
cards.happens: Search card scoped to that job.

cards.title: Refine the search in conversation
cards.hook: Narrow down like you're talking to a sourcer.
cards.desc: Add or remove skills, exclude cities or employers, limit notice period, ask for immediate joiners, or show more. Nyra suggests the next filter to try and does not re-ask for slots you already filled.
cards.happens: Updated search card with suggested next filters.
cards.note: Gender and industry filters are read but results vary.

cards.title: Open full results / Chat with Nyra search
cards.hook: Move from chat to the full search page in one tap.
cards.desc: Opens the full Search with Nyra results, or continues the search on the Chat with Nyra page. Can also show matches on a job's tracker.
cards.happens: Deep link to the search results or the tracker.

cards.title: Global Search and Tagged Search shortcuts
cards.hook: Every search mode is one sentence away.
cards.desc: Opens Global Search (prefilled with your skills or job) or Tagged Search for you.
prompts: “Search globally for Java developers in Pune”
cards.happens: Opens the matching search page, prefilled.
cards.who: Global Search: Anyone with Global Search access. Tagged Search: Anyone who can see the candidate list / Tagged Search
cards.note: These are separate search products: Nyra opens them, but results are shown on those pages.

cards.title: Save this search
cards.hook: Keep your best searches one click away.
cards.desc: Saves the current search to your Saved searches.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Saved to Recent & saved searches.

cards.title: Search alerts for new matches
cards.hook: Never miss a new match. Nyra checks for you every morning.
cards.desc: Turns a search into a daily alert. Every morning at 08:30 (India time; New York time for US workspaces) Nyra runs the search for you and tells you about new matches.
prompts: “Tell me when a new Java developer in Pune comes in”
“Alert me for new React developers in Bangalore”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm (undo for 30 s). New matches arrive as an in-app notification and an email to you.
cards.who: Anyone who can see the candidate list / Tagged Search
cards.note: One notification per alert per day, a capped number of alerts per person. An alert pauses after 7 days of inactivity (you get one email) and comes back with “turn my search alert back on”.

cards.title: Candidates like this one
cards.hook: Found a great candidate? Nyra finds more like them.
cards.desc: Takes a candidate's role, top skills and experience band and searches for similar people, leaving the original person out. Nyra offers an “Only <their city>” filter button.
cards.happens: Search card, just like a normal find, with Show more and refine.
cards.note: The person must be on a job you can see. If the name fits two people, Nyra asks which one.

cards.title: Who applied recently
cards.hook: See every new applicant across your jobs, including career-page applies.
cards.desc: Counts the people who applied or were tagged to your jobs in a period, per job, including applications from the career page, and lists the latest ones.
prompts: “Who applied this week for my jobs?”
cards.happens: Answer card with counts per job, the latest 10 people with profile links, and a tracker link.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Periods: today, yesterday, this or last week (weeks start Monday), this or last month, last 7 or 30 days. Default is this week.

areas.title: Understanding candidates
areas.text: Everything you need to know about a candidate, in one question.

cards.title: Candidate summary and profile
cards.hook: The candidate in a glance, with the full profile one tap away.
cards.desc: Summarises a candidate from their profile (role, experience, skills, location, notice) and links to the full profile. Works for candidates who aren't on any job, and if a candidate's search details are missing, the profile opens from the saved record instead of failing.
cards.happens: Summary card with an Open profile link.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Where is this candidate in the pipeline?
cards.hook: Instant pipeline status: no clicking through trackers.
cards.desc: Shows a candidate's current stage on each job and links to the tracker.
cards.happens: Answer card with a tracker link.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Compare two candidates
cards.hook: Side-by-side comparison for confident shortlisting.
cards.desc: Puts two candidates side by side for a job: experience, skills, notice and match score.
cards.happens: Comparison card.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Duplicate check: “Has this person applied before?”
cards.hook: Catch duplicates before they cost you a submission.
cards.desc: Checks whether the candidate is already on file or has applied before, and on which jobs.
cards.happens: Answer card listing the matching records.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Shows only jobs you can see. Merging duplicates isn't available.

cards.title: Last contact and profile owner
cards.hook: Know who spoke to the candidate last, and when, before you call.
cards.desc: Tells you when the candidate was last contacted and who owns their profile.
prompts: “When did we last speak to Sanjay Patil?”
cards.happens: Answer card.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: What did the panel say?
cards.hook: Every round's feedback, summarised in one answer.
cards.desc: Summarises interview feedback and outcomes across all rounds for a candidate.
prompts: “What did the panel say about Suresh Babu, all rounds?”
cards.happens: Answer card, round by round.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Interview questions to ask
cards.hook: Walk into every interview with sharp, job-specific questions.
cards.desc: Gives the job's own evaluation questions, plus probing questions on the skills to test: the ones you name and the job's must-haves the CV doesn't mention.
prompts: “What should I ask Karthik in round 2? He's weak on Kafka”
cards.happens: List of questions in the panel.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Built from the job's evaluation questions and fixed templates, not free-written. If the job has no questions and no skill to probe, Nyra says so.

cards.title: Offer status
cards.hook: “Has she accepted?”, answered instantly.
cards.desc: Shows a candidate's offer status on your jobs, or lists the open offers.
cards.happens: Answer card.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Same-name candidates and clients
cards.hook: Two Priyas? Nyra asks which one: no mix-ups.
cards.desc: When a name matches more than one candidate or client, Nyra shows lettered choices with job and stage (or client code) so you pick the right one.
prompts: “Add a note on Priya then A) Priya Shah, JC-12, L1 · B) Priya Nair, JC-40, Screening”
cards.happens: Lettered buttons; nothing happens until you choose.

areas.title: Jobs and requirements
areas.text: From a one-line brief to a live job, plus a sharp eye on every open role.

cards.title: Job status
cards.hook: Ask about any job and get a status report on the spot.
cards.desc: Shows where a job stands: positions, candidates at each stage, last activity and deadline. Find it by job code or title.
prompts: “What's happening on the Salesforce QA role?”
cards.happens: Answer card with a link to the job.

cards.title: Jobs at risk
cards.hook: Spot slipping jobs before your client does.
cards.desc: Lists jobs at risk: deadline near or passed, no submissions, or no recent activity.
cards.happens: Answer card listing each job and why it's at risk.

cards.title: Jobs closing soon
cards.hook: See this week's deadlines at a glance.
cards.desc: Lists jobs whose deadline falls this week or next week.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Jobs on hold
cards.desc: Lists jobs on hold, for everyone or for one client.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Jobs nobody is working on
cards.hook: No open role gets forgotten.
cards.desc: Lists open jobs with no recruiter assigned.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Duplicate open jobs
cards.hook: Stop the same role being worked twice.
cards.desc: Finds open jobs that look like the same role for the same client.
prompts: “Is there already a React developer job for Nimbus open?”
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Open roles, ageing jobs and busiest clients
cards.desc: Counts open jobs, shows ageing jobs, and ranks clients by open roles.
prompts: “Which client has the most open roles?”
cards.happens: Answer card with a link to the filtered requirement list.

cards.title: Which client is this job for? Who's the SPOC?
cards.desc: Names the client and the client contact (SPOC) on a job.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Must-haves, nice-to-haves and evaluation questions
cards.desc: Reads a job's must-have and nice-to-have skills and its evaluation questions, and opens the job's Evaluation tab to add more.
cards.happens: Answer card, or a deep link to the job's Evaluation tab.

cards.title: Draft a job description
cards.hook: A polished JD from a one-line brief, in seconds.
cards.desc: Writes a JD draft from a short brief (asking for the must-haves), then fills it into the job form with the title and client.
prompts: “Write a JD for a senior backend engineer”
cards.happens: Draft in the panel with Apply to form, Open job form and Create this job buttons.
cards.note: Starting a JD from an attached file is available, but an unreadable file only shows a short warning.

cards.title: Refine a job description
cards.desc: Tightens or rewrites a JD for seniority, tone or length.
prompts: “Tighten this JD for a senior hire”
cards.happens: Revised draft in the panel.

cards.title: JD health check
cards.hook: Catch gaps and biased wording before the JD goes out.
cards.desc: Checks the JD on screen for what candidates look for first (title, location, experience, CTC, must-have skills, responsibilities, notice period) and flags gender-coded or exclusionary words with a neutral alternative.
cards.happens: List of issues found.

cards.title: Usual skills, experience and CTC for a role
cards.hook: Benchmarks from your own hiring history.
cards.desc: Looks at your workspace's past jobs for the same role and tells you the usual skills and the typical experience and CTC range.
prompts: “What skills do we usually ask for a QA engineer?”
“Typical experience for a senior Java role?”
cards.happens: Answer card naming the past jobs it used.
cards.note: Only as good as your past jobs for that role. Nyra says so when there are none.

cards.title: Best past JD for a role
cards.hook: Reuse what worked: the JD behind your best hires.
cards.desc: Finds the past JD for the same role that led to the most hires or applications.
prompts: “Show me our best past JD for a data analyst”
cards.happens: Answer card with a link to that job.

cards.title: Create the job from the drafted JD
cards.hook: From brief to live requirement without opening a form.
cards.desc: After drafting, Nyra asks for the client and its contact, then creates the job using the same checks as the job form. Designation values are stored as ids (not free-text job titles), so requirement lists stay stable.
prompts: “Use this JD to create the job”
cards.happens: Preview of every field (including defaults such as one Permanent position and you as Org SPOC) then tap Confirm. The job gets its job code, screening questions and apply link.
cards.note: Can't be undone from chat. Defaults it fills are shown on the preview so you can change them on the job page afterwards.

cards.title: Put a job on hold, close it or reopen it
cards.hook: Change a job's status in one sentence.
cards.desc: Changes a job's status exactly as the requirement page does. Closing also takes it off EzRefer.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s on hold and reopen.
cards.who: Team leads who can view requirements
cards.note: A close can't be undone from chat.

cards.title: Assign a recruiter to a job
cards.desc: Adds a teammate as recruiter on a job.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm.
cards.note: Works best with the job code. By title alone, Nyra may ask which job.

areas.title: Interviews and scheduling
areas.text: Book, move and wrap up interviews in plain language, with feedback chased automatically.

cards.title: Find a free slot and book an interview
cards.hook: “Book Priya tomorrow at 3”, done. Nyra checks your calendar and picks the next round.
cards.desc: Offers your free hours from the EzRecruit interview calendar, then the job, the candidate and the round. If the time is taken, it offers the nearest free slots.
cards.happens: Slot buttons then preview then Confirm. The candidate gets the interview details by email if they have one on file. The interview appears on the Interview Roster.
cards.who: Anyone who can view the Interview Roster
cards.note: Needs at least 1 hour's notice. Uses the EzRecruit calendar only, not Outlook or Google. Won't double-book a candidate who already has an upcoming interview.

cards.title: Reschedule an interview
cards.desc: Moves an existing interview to a new time.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. The candidate is emailed if they have an address on file.
cards.who: Anyone who can view the Interview Roster
cards.note: Same 1-hour notice rule. Someone who isn't the interview's owner is asked to check first.

cards.title: Cancel an interview
cards.desc: Cancels an interview and puts the candidate back at their previous stage with your reason. You can choose to tell the candidate.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Optional email to the candidate (it never includes your reason). Undo for 30 s if no email went out.
cards.who: The interview's owner or their team lead

cards.title: Mark a no-show
cards.desc: Records a past interview as a no-show.
prompts: “Priya didn't show up for the interview”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s.
cards.who: The interview's owner or their team lead
cards.note: Only for interviews whose time has passed.

cards.title: Send a slot-picker link on WhatsApp
cards.hook: Let candidates pick their own slot from WhatsApp.
cards.desc: Sends the candidate a WhatsApp link where they choose an interview slot, using the Interview Scheduler.
prompts: “Send Ravi a slot link for JC-123”
cards.happens: Preview then tap Confirm. WhatsApp message to the candidate.
cards.who: Anyone who can view the Interview Roster
cards.note: Needs the candidate's phone on file.

cards.title: Automatic interview reminders (WhatsApp)
cards.hook: Fewer no-shows: candidates get a WhatsApp reminder an hour before.
cards.desc: About an hour before an interview, the candidate gets a WhatsApp reminder with a Confirm availability button. Covers Scheduler slot-picker bookings and interviews booked from the tracker or by Nyra's “book” action (current In Process / scheduled stage only; each booking is claimed once so nobody gets two reminders).
cards.happens: WhatsApp to the candidate.
cards.note: Kill switch INTERVIEW_TRACKER_REMINDER_ENABLED (default on). UAT WhatsApps redirect via NyraCandidateMailGuard; prod uses the real number on file.

cards.title: Set the interview panel for a job
cards.desc: Sets, adds or removes the teammates on a job's interview panel. Feedback nudges then go to them.
prompts: “Set the interview panel for JC-123 to Asha and Ravi”
“Add Ravi to the panel for JC-123”
“Remove Asha from the interview panel for JC-123”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s.
cards.who: Team leads who can view requirements
cards.note: Only teammates in your own team.

cards.title: Nudge interviewers who owe feedback
cards.hook: Chase pending feedback across the team in one line.
cards.desc: Finds interviews still waiting for feedback, works out who owes each one (the job's panel, otherwise the recruiter who booked it) and nudges them.
cards.happens: Preview listing who will be nudged then Confirm. Each person gets an in-app notification.
cards.who: Team leads who can view the Interview Roster
cards.note: Teammates only, never anyone outside the company. A capped number of people per nudge.

cards.title: Feedback you owe, and recording feedback
cards.hook: Clear your feedback backlog without leaving the chat.
cards.desc: Lists the interviews you owe feedback on and records the outcome and comment, step by step with buttons if you don't name anyone.
cards.happens: Owed list then outcome buttons then Confirm. The stage moves the way the tracker's feedback form would move it.
cards.who: Anyone who can view the Interview Roster
cards.note: Outcome choices come from your workspace's own stages.

cards.title: Email interview details to a candidate
cards.desc: Sends the candidate the interview details email (Interview Mail).
cards.happens: Preview then tap Confirm. Email to the candidate, sent from your connected mailbox.
cards.note: Needs your mailbox connected in EzRecruit.

cards.title: Email the interview roster to a client
cards.desc: Sends the client the interview roster (schedule) for a job, or an interview reminder.
prompts: “Send the interview roster for JC-123 to the client”
cards.happens: Preview then tap Confirm. Email to the client contact.
cards.who: Anyone allowed to email the interview roster to clients
cards.note: Needs your mailbox connected.

cards.title: Interview numbers and the roster
cards.desc: Counts interviews scheduled or conducted for you, your team, a teammate, a job or a client, and opens the Interview Roster. Absolute dates, weekdays and day ranges are honoured (the reply names that date, not “this month”).
prompts: “How many interviews did I schedule this week?”
cards.happens: Answer card linking to the filtered Interview Roster.
cards.who: Anyone who can view the Interview Roster

areas.title: Pipeline actions
areas.text: Move candidates, update offers, email clients and candidates. Always with a preview, often with undo.

cards.title: Shortlist a candidate
cards.desc: Shortlists a candidate onto a job. Nyra offers job and candidate buttons if you don't name them.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Bulk shortlist
cards.hook: Shortlist the top five in one go.
cards.desc: Shortlists several candidates from the last list or search in one step.
cards.happens: One preview listing everyone then one Confirm.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Move a candidate to another stage
cards.desc: Moves a candidate to the next or a named stage. Stage choices come from your workspace's real stages.
prompts: “Move Ravi on JC-1 to client round”
cards.happens: Stage buttons then preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Reject with a reason
cards.hook: A clean rejection with the reason logged, and a polite regret email if you want one.
cards.desc: Moves the candidate to the right reject stage for where they are, with your reason recorded as the tracker does. Optionally sends a polite regret email.
prompts: “Reject Rahul for JG-9474, not enough Kafka”
“Reject Priya on JG-9474 because salary expectations are too high”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. The regret email is optional and never includes the reason. Undo for 30 s when no email went out.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Once a regret email has gone, it can't be undone.

cards.title: Offer and joining updates
cards.hook: “Ravi joined yesterday”: logged, counted in closures, done.
cards.desc: Marks an offer released, accepted, joined or dropped (with a reason), carrying the offer details already on record. Joining logs the joining date, so it counts in Closures.
prompts: “Mark Priya's offer as dropped by the client”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Nyra never makes up offer details. If no CTC is on record, it sends you to the feedback form to release the offer.

cards.title: Add a note on a candidate
cards.desc: Adds a note to the candidate's record.
prompts: “Add a note on Ravi: wants 20% hike”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Phrase it as “note on <name>: …”. The wording “add a note to <name>” isn't understood yet.

cards.title: Add a candidate from a CV
cards.hook: Drop a CV in the chat. Nyra reads it and creates the candidate.
cards.desc: Upload a CV in the panel. Nyra reads it with the Add Candidate page's own reader and shows what it found. Names come from the resume (not email autofill), and year ranges such as (2022-2026) are not treated as phone numbers. Repeat uploads of the same file hit a content-hash cache so the second parse is instant.
cards.happens: Preview of the parsed details then Confirm. The candidate is created and becomes searchable straight away.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Refuses a candidate whose email or phone is already on file. Can't be undone from chat.

cards.title: Update a candidate's notice period, CTC or phone
cards.desc: Changes one field on the candidate record, exactly as the Edit Candidate page would.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Notice period, current or expected CTC, and phone only.

cards.title: Request documents from a candidate
cards.hook: Collect PAN, payslips and the rest without writing an email.
cards.desc: Emails the candidate a request for documents: your workspace's standard list for the job's region, or the documents you name.
prompts: “Ask Priya for her PAN and payslips”
cards.happens: Preview then tap Confirm. Email to the address on the candidate's record; replies come to you.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Goes only to the email on the candidate's record.

cards.title: Follow-up, thank-you and regret emails
cards.desc: Sends a candidate a follow-up, thank-you or polite regret email.
cards.happens: Preview then tap Confirm. Email to the address on the candidate's record.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Email only (WhatsApp is used just for slot links and reminders).

cards.title: Send the tracker or CVs to the client
cards.hook: Send the client their shortlist with the Excel tracker attached, in one line.
cards.desc: Emails the client contact (SPOC) the candidate tracker for a job, with the Excel file attached, or sends selected CVs.
prompts: “Send the tracker for JC-123 to the client”
cards.happens: Preview of recipient and candidates then tap Confirm. Email from your connected mailbox with the .xlsx tracker attached.
cards.who: Anyone allowed to email trackers to clients
cards.note: Needs your mailbox connected in EzRecruit.

cards.title: Reminders for yourself
cards.hook: “Remind me Friday to chase Acme.” Nyra won't forget.
cards.desc: Sets a personal reminder that arrives as an in-app notification at the time you chose.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. In-app notification when it's due. Undo for 30 s.
cards.note: In-app only, not email.

areas.title: Goals and targets
areas.text: Set, track and respond to CV goals without opening the Goals page.

cards.title: Goal status
cards.desc: Counts and lists your goals: open, waiting for acceptance, overdue and completed (any time window).
prompts: “How many goals do I have open?”
“Goals I closed in the last 12 months”
cards.happens: Answer card linking to the Goals page.

cards.title: CV target vs sourced; who has no goals
cards.desc: Compares CV targets with CVs sourced, and lists teammates with no goals.
prompts: “Who on my team has no goals?”
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Assign a CV goal
cards.hook: Hand out sourcing targets in one sentence.
cards.desc: Gives a teammate a CV target on a job, with a deadline.
prompts: “Create a goal for Priya on JC-1”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. The teammate is notified.
cards.note: Goals are CV targets per job.

cards.title: Update a goal
cards.desc: Changes a goal's target or deadline.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. The goal's owner is notified.

cards.title: Accept or decline a goal
cards.desc: Accepts or declines a goal someone sent you.
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm.
cards.note: Only goals sent to you by someone else and still waiting for an answer.

cards.title: Nudge everyone with overdue goals
cards.hook: Chase every overdue CV goal on the team in one line.
cards.desc: Finds teammates whose accepted goals are past the deadline and still short of the CV target, and nudges each one.
cards.happens: Preview listing the people and their goals then tap Confirm. Each teammate gets an in-app notification that opens their Goals.
cards.who: Team leads who can view goals
cards.note: Your own team only, up to 25 people per nudge, and each goal at most once a day. No email or WhatsApp.

cards.title: Set role targets for a period
cards.hook: Set the quarter's targets for a whole role in one sentence.
cards.desc: Sets targets (for example closures) for everyone in a role or team for a month, quarter or year, using the same save as the Team Targets page.
prompts: “Set Q4 targets for senior recruiters: 6 closures”
“Set next month's targets for the Delhi team: 4 closures”
cards.happens: Preview of every team affected then tap Confirm. The Team Targets history shows “Set from Nyra”.
cards.who: Anyone who can set team targets on the Analytics side
cards.note: Quarters follow your financial year. Numbers you don't mention keep their current value. Refuses periods that have ended. Can't be undone from chat. Up to 20 teams at once.

areas.title: Clients
areas.text: Keep client context current from the chat.

cards.title: Add a note on a client
cards.desc: Adds a note to the client's Notes section.
prompts: “Add a note on Amazon: budget approved”
“Note on Flipkart: new hiring manager from January”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s.

cards.title: Show a client's notes
cards.desc: Reads back the notes on a client.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Add a client contact
cards.desc: Adds a contact (SPOC) to a client at one of its locations.
prompts: “Add Rahul Sharma (rahul@amazon.com) as a contact for Amazon”
cards.happens: Preview then Confirm. Undo for 30 s, unless a job already uses the contact.
cards.note: Refuses an email already used by another contact.

cards.title: Create a client
cards.desc: Opens the new-client form.
cards.happens: Deep link to the client form.
cards.note: Opens the form. It isn't pre-filled.

areas.title: Reports and metrics
areas.text: Every number your managers ask for, instantly, with a link to the page behind it.

cards.title: Pipeline volumes
cards.desc: Submissions, selections, offers, interviews scheduled and conducted, and feedback owed, for any time window - including absolute dates (nov 11), weekdays (this Wednesday) and day ranges (between today and Friday, Nov 11 and 12).
cards.happens: Answer card. Tap through to the filtered page. The reply names the date or range you asked for.
cards.who: Anyone who can view that page (tracker, roster, closures)

cards.title: Closures, closure rate and best week
cards.desc: Closures for any period, client or job; closure rate against target; your best week for closures over the last 8 weeks.
prompts: “Which was my best week for closures?”
cards.happens: Answer card linking to Closures.

cards.title: Targets and revenue
cards.hook: Revenue and targets on demand. No dashboard digging.
cards.desc: Hire targets vs achieved, revenue target for the period, and revenue achieved (the same figures as Analytics).
prompts: “How much revenue have we closed this month?”
cards.happens: Answer card linking to Analytics.
cards.who: Targets: Anyone who can view closures. Revenue: Anyone who can view analytics

cards.title: Funnel for a client or job
cards.hook: See exactly where candidates drop off.
cards.desc: Shows how many candidates reached each stage, from submitted to joined.
cards.happens: Answer card.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cards.title: Average time to fill
cards.desc: Median days from opening a job to filling it, for the period you ask.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Top drop and rejection reasons
cards.desc: Ranks the most common reasons candidates were rejected or dropped.
cards.happens: Answer card.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker
cards.note: Only as good as the reasons recorded in feedback.

cards.title: Best performing clients
cards.desc: Ranks clients by closures.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: AI searches run by the team
cards.desc: Counts the AI searches you or your team ran.
prompts: “How many AI searches did my team run?”
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Scorecard and leaderboard
cards.desc: Opens your performance scorecard and the team leaderboard.
cards.happens: Answer card with a link.

cards.title: Compare with last period; me vs my team
cards.hook: Instant trend lines: up or down vs last month.
cards.desc: Puts any number next to the previous period, and switches between your own numbers and your team's.
cards.happens: Answer card with the change shown.
cards.note: Team numbers cover the people you can see.

cards.title: How is this number worked out?
cards.desc: Explains how a metric is calculated.
cards.happens: Short definition.

cards.title: Email me a report
cards.hook: A report in your inbox, on request.
cards.desc: Emails you the report you ask for, for example the Closures list for a period as an Excel file with the same rows you see on the Closures page.
prompts: “Send me this month's closures as Excel”
“Mail me the closures for this quarter as a spreadsheet”
cards.happens: Preview then tap Confirm. Email with the .xlsx to your own address.
cards.note: Goes only to you.

cards.title: Open any report page
cards.desc: Opens the requirement report, client performance report, dashboard or AI usage page.
prompts: “How much AI credit do we have left?”
cards.happens: Deep link to the page.
cards.who: Analytics viewers. AI usage: workspace admins.

areas.title: Team
areas.text: Balance the load and hand over work cleanly.

cards.title: Recruiter load
cards.hook: See who's stretched before deadlines slip.
cards.desc: Shows how many open jobs and active candidates a recruiter has, compared with the team median.
cards.happens: Answer card.

cards.title: Reassign a leaver's jobs and candidates
cards.hook: Someone leaving? Move their whole portfolio to a colleague in one confirmed step.
cards.desc: Moves a person's jobs, candidates and open goals (and optionally their closure credit) to a colleague, exactly as the Users screen does.
prompts: “Move Priya's jobs and candidates to Ravi”
“Priya is leaving, move her work to Ravi”
cards.happens: Preview with counts then tap Confirm. The app records the transfer history.
cards.note: Can't be undone from chat. Confirm refuses if the counts changed after the preview. The successor must be an active employee, not a collaborator.

cards.title: Employees and permissions pages
cards.desc: Opens the employee list, the add-employee form or Permissions, and explains how permission groups work.
cards.happens: Deep link with short steps.
cards.note: Nyra explains permissions but doesn't change them.

areas.title: Network sourcing
areas.text: Reach network opportunities and reviews from the chat.

cards.title: Network Opportunities and pending reviews
cards.desc: Opens Network Opportunities on the requests or reviews tab, and tells you where approvals happen.
cards.happens: Deep link to the right tab.
cards.note: Approvals and sharing happen on the page. Nyra doesn't approve or share for you yet.

cards.title: How network sourcing works
cards.desc: Explains Network Opportunities from the Knowledge Center.
cards.happens: Answer from the Knowledge Center.

areas.title: Guided help
areas.text: Onboarding on autopilot: tours, step-by-step walkthroughs and instant answers.

cards.title: Page tours
cards.hook: New user? Nyra gives a guided tour of any screen.
cards.desc: Spotlight tours of the main screens: dashboard, requirement list, create requirement, Search with Nyra, Global Search, candidate list / Tagged Search, candidate profile, Interview Roster, Scheduler, goals, closures, clients, reports, employees, permissions, settings, Import Center, Nyra Conversations, Network Opportunities and the Nyra panel itself.
cards.happens: Opens the page and runs the tour (Show me button).
cards.who: Anyone who can open that page

cards.title: Step-by-step walkthroughs
cards.hook: Nyra coaches you through a real hire, page by page, and does the steps with you.
cards.desc: Multi-page walkthroughs that coach you and can do each step with you: hire someone end to end (find, shortlist, schedule), clear the feedback you owe, create a job and source, offer to joining, and set up a client.
prompts: “Show me how to set up a client”
cards.happens: A walkthrough bar guides you across pages.
cards.who: Hiring / jobthensource: Anyone who can search candidates. Feedback: Anyone who can view the Interview Roster. Client setup: Anyone who can view clients

cards.title: Knowledge Center answers
cards.hook: Product questions answered on the spot, with a link to the guide.
cards.desc: Answers how-to and what-is questions from the EzRecruit Knowledge Center: creating requirements, searching, the roster, closures, analytics, reports, Import Center, adding teammates, first login and more.
prompts: “How do I import from another ATS?”
cards.happens: Short answer with a link to the Knowledge Center page.
cards.note: Some how-to topics (Tagged Search, scheduling an interview, goals) give shorter answers than others.

cards.title: Straight answers to “why” questions
cards.desc: Clear answers to common puzzles: why a search found nothing, why the pipeline isn't moving, why you can't accept a goal, closure vs offer vs selection, whether you must type every candidate, renaming “recruiter”.
cards.happens: Curated answer.

cards.title: Jump to any page
cards.hook: Say where you want to go. Nyra takes you there.
cards.desc: Opens pages by name: notifications, settings, masters, onboarding, profile and password, candidate list, a job's tracker or scheduler, scheduler history, goals overview, team targets, feedback master and more.
cards.happens: Deep link, permission-checked.
cards.who: Anyone who can open that page
cards.note: Nyra never handles passwords: it opens the page.

areas.title: Safety and trust
areas.text: Built for real recruitment data: nothing changes without your say-so.

cards.title: Preview and Confirm before every change
cards.hook: Nyra never acts behind your back. Every change is previewed first.
cards.desc: Every write shows a preview card (what, who, and who will be notified) with Confirm, Change and Cancel. Anything that sends a message outside the company needs a tap on Confirm.
cards.happens: Nothing is written until you confirm.

cards.title: 30-second undo
cards.hook: Changed your mind? Undo.
cards.desc: Most reversible changes can be undone for 30 seconds: shortlist, stage moves, notes, reject (without email), cancel and no-show, job hold or reopen, panel, client notes and contacts, search alerts and reminders.
cards.happens: The change is reversed.
cards.note: Not for emails that have gone out, job close, new jobs or candidates, or ownership transfer.

cards.title: Sees only what you can see
cards.hook: Nyra respects every permission and hierarchy rule you already have.
cards.desc: Every answer and action uses your own permissions and team scope. Help only offers what you're allowed to do.

cards.title: No double actions, no stale taps
cards.desc: Tapping Confirm twice never writes twice. A preview left too long or overtaken by other questions expires safely.

cards.title: Safe email
cards.desc: Candidate emails go only to the address on the candidate's record, and suppressed or bouncing addresses are skipped. Rejection and cancellation reasons never appear in candidate emails.

cards.title: Instant off switch
cards.desc: EzRecruit can pause any single action, or all actions, at once without a release.

cards.title: Fast answers from your own data
cards.hook: Answers come straight from your EzRecruit data, so they're fast and consistent.
cards.desc: Numbers, job and candidate answers are read directly from your EzRecruit data with fixed rules, not made up by an AI model. Nyra also remembers how it understood earlier questions, so repeat questions come back faster.

cards.title: Honest when it can't help
cards.desc: When something is outside what Nyra can do, it says so plainly and offers what it can do. In production these gaps (plus unknowns, action failures and thumbs-down) also open or bump a Backlog card marked [Nyra auto] for the product team.
cards.happens: Honest reply plus suggestions; a Backlog card is filed or counted in production.
cards.note: Backlog intake is production-only (flag NYRA_BACKLOG_INTAKE_ENABLED). UAT never creates tickets.

cards.title: Full audit trail
cards.desc: Every action Nyra takes is logged with who asked, what changed and when.

cards.title: Faster resume re-reads (content cache)
cards.desc: Parsed resume content is cached by content hash (resume_content_cache). A second upload of the same file returns instantly instead of re-parsing, and missing-table errors on US tenants are gone.
cards.who: Anyone who can work the candidate tracker

cant.instead: Free slots come from the EzRecruit interview calendar only. Asking to sync Outlook or Google files a production Backlog card for the team; Nyra still won't read those calendars today.

cant.cant: Block personal time on your calendar
cant.instead: “Just block this time” sends you to the Schedule page.

cant.cant: Book an interview less than an hour ahead
cant.instead: Nyra needs at least one hour's notice.
Built, but not switched on in production yet. There is no daily digest email.

cant.cant: Approve, share or source on the network from chat
cant.instead: Network sourcing through Nyra is planned for later. Today Nyra opens the right Network Opportunities tab.
Nyra finds duplicates, but merging isn't offered.
Out of scope. Nyra emails one candidate or one client contact at a time.
Follow-ups, thank-yous and regrets go by email. WhatsApp is used only for slot links and interview reminders.
Only the Closures report can be emailed as Excel.
Nyra explains them and opens the page; changes are made on the page.
Nyra opens the form; you fill it in.

cant.cant: Filter reliably by gender or industry
cant.instead: These filters are read, but results vary.

cant.cant: Assign a job by title alone, every time
cant.instead: Using the job code is reliable; by title, Nyra may ask which job.
